name: IRNSS-1L (NVS-03)
location_str: Satish Dhawan Space Centre Second Launch Pad @ Satish Dhawan Space Centre, IND
slot_a_text: This is a replacement satellite for the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System. The constellation will provide India with an alternative to GPS and will be used for military and civilian use. Located at a geosynchronous orbit, the system will be operated by the Indian government.
slot_b_text: A transfer orbit is a long ellipse. Over the coming weeks the satellite raises its own low point until the whole orbit sits 36,000 km up, where one lap takes exactly a day and it appears to hover over one spot.
